headline: Clearview AI Is Testing an AI Tool That Would Let Cops Unearth Your Life Online
context: InquiryIQ, a previously unreported prototype, tested a model from xAI, maker of Grok, to surface associates, social accounts, and other information about people identified through Clearview.
